Battery Module Assembly.name: Graphite
Battery Module Assembly.reasoning: Primary anode material allowing lithium intercalation, universally used in commercial lithium-ion batteries.

Battery Management System.reasoning: Core semiconductor material for integrated circuits that control battery management, absolutely essential and industry standard.

Battery Management System.name: Gold
